scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c red,blue "npm run dev -w @onet/api" "npm run dev -w @onet/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @onet/api && npm run build -w @onet/web
scripts.setup: npm run i18n && npm run db:setup -w @onet/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @onet/api && npm run typecheck -w @onet/web
